## Stack.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `direction` :: Stack axis: vertical column or horizontal row.
- `gap` :: Space between items on the shared gap ladder.
- `align` :: Cross-axis placement: `start`, `center`, `end`, or `stretch` to fill it. Defaults to `stretch`.
- `justify` :: Main-axis distribution on the shared `Align` axis; `between` pushes the first and last item to the ends.
- `wrap` :: Wrap children onto multiple lines when stacking horizontally.
- `dividers` :: Draw hairline borders between adjacent stack children.
- `children` :: The items to arrange, drawn in source order.
